reader.edition-search: grep -rn 'Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|IsActive' over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/{FileConnector,FileRegistry,KeyedConnector,IndexedConnector,FixedFileAttributes}.cs and SequentialIoBinder/SequentialIoEmitter/StatementValidation: the keyed OPEN body (KeyedConnector.OpenCore), the presence/authority/attribute/write-capability steps of FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered and the emitter take no edition; only the sharing and lock sites listed do
reader.requirement: At --std 85 OPEN I-O of an indexed file succeeds only on a file that supports the I-O-mode operations of Table 2 (READ, REWRITE, DELETE, START in sequential/dynamic access, WRITE in random/dynamic access) and then places it in the open mode for both input and output; a file that cannot support them is unsuccessful with '37' (IX.1.3.4 (4)c.2), the file unaffected.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002+): at 85 a host share-mode refusal of the OPEN answers '30' instead of '61' (catch in FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered)
Table 19 arbitration runs only where the sharing facility is in effect; at 85 every same-run-unit OPEN is a normal open
default sharing mode: AllOther at 85 (no facility), mode-dependent from 2002
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: at 85 CLOSE WITH LOCK locks the physical file ('38' through any file-name), from 2002 the file connector
carries --std into CobolFile.RegisterIndexed so FileConnector.Edition is 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for this rule: the I-O mode, the write-capability '37' and the keyed OPEN body are edition-free; only the 2002+ sharing facility (Table 19, '61') differs, and that is not this rule

reader.notes: FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered asks the write capability once for every non-INPUT mode on a present file (HostFile.PermitsWrite gives '37') before KeyedConnector.OpenCore attaches the store; the 85 arm is the same code as 2023 for this rule. A read-only host file answered 37 for I-O, EXTEND and OUTPUT and stayed intact.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR13 whole, Table 2 and IX.1.3.4 (4)c.2; read FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered (lines 1192-1311): the write-capability probe for every non-INPUT mode on a present file (HostFile.PermitsWrite -> '37') and TakeRunUnitFileLock, which returns null at 85 (SharingFacilityInEffect false), so no '61' path. Probe r13c.cob (class c, the 2002+ OPEN I-O ... WITH LOCK): refused at 85, COBOL5506 'The word LOCK is not expected here'. Probe r17.cob: OPEN INPUT F I-O F G gave G (random access) I-O 00, F's WRITE in input mode 48. Reader's read-only-file probe (37 for I-O, file intact) stands. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR13 'supports the input and output operations that are permitted for an indexed file'.
